Technical guide

Optimizing Temperature, Time, and Kinetics in Research-Scale SPPS

How temperature and coupling time influence reaction kinetics, side reactions, and crude purity in research-scale peptide synthesis. Explore model peptide results, coupling chemistries, and the role of solvent preheating.

Technical guide

Scaling Up SPPS: Choosing the Right Thermal Technology

How temperature control affects crude purity, yield, and process consistency as peptide synthesis moves from research to pilot and commercial scale. Explore conduction, microwave, and induction heating, solvent pre-heating, and real-time temperature feedback.

Read more →

Selection guide

How to Choose a Peptide Synthesizer

A practical CSBio selection guide for choosing the right automated peptide synthesizer for research, process development, pilot production, GMP manufacturing, and commercial scale peptide production.

Read more →

Recorded talk

Modernizing SPPS for Better CMC Outcomes

Recorded live at TIDES Europe, the leading international conference for peptides, CSBio’s Hanson Chang was invited to showcase the latest solid-phase peptide synthesis technologies to improve CMC outcomes—boosting yield and control while reducing solvent use. The talk highlights practical, scalable approaches to process development and tech transfer in peptide manufacturing.

About Us

CSBio is a leading peptide instrumentation manufacturing company located in Silicon Valley, California.

CSBio provides research scale peptide synthesizers, pilot scale peptide synthesizers, commercial scale peptide synthesizers, and DNA/RNA oligonucleotide synthesizers.
